title: SIZED-QTY-META-MISMATCH: order_packages.meta.sized_qty_by_account records 2x the placed qty on 27 bybit_1 packages; 7 also show a non-bracket reduce-only order closing the whole position
clears_when: deployed:#25446 AND data_n:bybit_1 order_packages created>=2026-11-12T19:20:38Z with a non-rejected bybit_1 trades row >=1, each with meta.placed_qty_by_account[bybit_1] within 1% (or one qtyStep) of position_size. Owner AM-OPS. Exact check in the 23:05Z HANDOFF note.
note: Found by lane JOURNAL-TRUTH 2026-11-12 while verifying partial-close suspects. MEASURED (diag journal order_packages + trades + bybit_raw_order_history): in the newest 400 order_packages (2026-08-03..11-12), 27 bybit_1 packages (e4_oi_shock_1h, claude_desk, trend_donchian_eth, trend_donchian_eth_prop) carry sized_qty_by_account exactly 2x the single journal row's position_size, and the venue entry order filled the JOURNAL size (e.g. pkg-ea7ad25c89394394 sized 232931.526, entry filled 116465). So something between sizing and placement halves bybit_1 orders while the package meta keeps the pre-halving figure. Not a money error (the journal matches the venue); it is a wrong record, and any reader that takes sized_qty_by_account as the placed size is wrong by 2x on bybit_1. Next: find the halving step (risk / slice / desk sizing) and either stamp the placed qty in meta or document the field as pre-adjustment. Population: evidence plan docs/research/evidence/partial-close-backfill-plan-2026-11-12.json (excluded list). 2026-11-12 11:06Z manager decision: Tier 2, owner AM-TRADING. QUESTIONS, in order: (1) is it only the meta field that is wrong (bookkeeping), or does the sizer compute 2x and something halve it at placement? (2) can the same path reach bybit_2 (real money)? Measured so far: bybit_2 had 1 'half' package in the newest 400, pkg-633f05fad1ee4c1d, and that one is a verified live-review partial close, not this; no bybit_2 instance of the entry-filled-half signature was found. (3) who sends the non-bracket whole-position closes on the 7 packages (trades 6995, 6945, 6938, 6890, 6858, 6810, 6771: e4_oi_shock_1h time stop? claude_desk close? the order ids are in docs/research/evidence/partial-close-backfill-plan-2026-11-12.json source data)? (1) ONLY THE META IS WRONG: sized_qty_by_account is stamped with the RiskManager size BEFORE positions.admit_slice resizes it. bybit_1 declares claude_desk 0.5 and e4_oi_shock_1h 0.5 (config/slice_allocation.yaml) -> placed = 0.5x sized; trend_donchian_eth* get pooled weights < 1. pkg-ea7ad25c89394394: sized 232931.526, slice_admission.qty 116465.763 (declared_slice, budget_trades 0.5) = placed = venue fill. Sizer is not computing 2x; nothing halves at the executor. (2) REAL MONEY: no entry doubling found. All 92 bybit_2 + bybit_portfolio entries since 2026-10-01 in that window: venue entry cum_exec_qty == journal position_size, except 5 rows whose journal size was later shrunk by recorded reduces (6528 -3.3-1.4; 6794 -18.7 [6807]; 6795 -5653.4 [6808]; 6529 -997.5-450.1) or by the verified live-review partial close on pkg-633f05fad1ee4c1d (6982 bybit_2 entry Sell 107.6, reduce-only Buy 53.8 at 2026-11-09T09:51Z; 6983 bybit_portfolio Sell 32478.5, reduce-only Buy 16239.2 at 10:52Z). That pkg is the 'XRP mirror filled double': the journal row was shrunk in place, no second entry. 3 unmatched rows (6973, 6931, 6544) are venue/risk refusals, never placed. No journal row on ANY account exceeds its sized qty. Code: Bybit _submit_order is a single place_order (no retry); slice_qty is min(sized, ...) so never above sized; maker post-only fallback is fenced to demo+paper. alpaca_live and prop rows: none in the window, code path only. (3) non-bracket closes: 6995/6810 e4_time_stop_24h (strategy_verdict); 6945/6890 live_review_close; 6938/6771 claude_desk strategy_close; 6858 was NOT non-bracket: venue shows its own PartialTakeProfit 25333 filled at 14:41Z.
